newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 5.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 5.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 42.49 points or 0.58 percent to close at 7269.66.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index lost 7.55 points to 1,119.28.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5158/63 a dollar at around 0025 GMT, a little higher from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Wednesday at 2.5175/85.
* Market continues to await release of April money supply data and April monthly trade data.
* Financial services firm AMMB Holdings reported above-forecast net earnings of 559.7 million for the year ended March 31, against 327 million the previous year.
* Arab-Malaysian Finance net profit at 251.67 million ringgit, against 180.69 million previously.
* Petroleum distributor Petronas Dagangan reported net profit of 157.83 million ringgit against 155.91 million for the year ended March 31.
* Property developer Country Heights said it was planning a 3-for-5 bonus issue.
